data.one_liner: Perform sentiment analysis on text and emojis using AFINN-165 wordlists.
data.what_it_does: Dart Sentiment analyzes arbitrary blocks of input text and emojis to compute sentiment scores. It supports multiple languages including English, Italian, French, and German, returning detailed metrics like positive/negative token breakdowns and comparative scores.
use_when: You need to analyze the sentiment of user reviews or comments in multiple languages.
You want to factor in emoji sentiment alongside text analysis.
avoid_when: You require complex machine learning-based natural language processing beyond dictionary lookups.
You are working with languages not included in the supported list.
strengths: Supports multiple languages (English, Italian, French, German).
Provides detailed breakdown tokens, positive, and negative word lists.
weaknesses: Relies on a static wordlist rather than advanced context-aware machine learning models.
